summary: Iteration 3 testing of the 3 new features: (A) Recap sharing (POST /api/trips/{id}/recap/share, public GET /api/recap/{token} and /api/recap/{token}/image/{memory_id}, RecapPage frontend + shareable public link), (B) Spending alerts (budget_alert notifications on category / total budget crossings, only on the crossing event, delivered to all registered members, red category chip in UI), (C) Trip chat context (Tara receives live trip financials via build_trip_context when trip_id is passed to /api/chat/stream, 'Watching your trip budget' subtitle + budget suggestion chips in ChatWidget). All 4 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iter3_features.py PASS (7.5s run) after a retry when the preview ingress ConnectTimeout flake (known infra issue from iter1/2) cleared. Frontend Playwright suite hits localhost:3000 (public preview URL is wrapped in the emergent.sh wake-up iframe loader — REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL still resolves so API integration is honest); Login as aarav@test.com verified. Recap flow: Memories tab shows play-recap-btn + copy-recap-link-btn; clicking play-recap-btn navigates to /recap/p0BDj9HSm7Q → recap-page loads; title slide shows 'Feature Test Trip', Goa dates, member names; recap-next-btn advances to photo slide (naturalWidth=80, image renders via /api/recap/{token}/image/{id}), note slide ('Great trip note'), stats slide (₹3,000 spent, 15% of budget, 2 travellers, 2 memories, biggest spend food ₹3,000); recap-playpause-btn toggles; recap-close-btn exits. Public unauth: fresh browser context (no cookies) opens /recap/p0BDj9HSm7Q and renders full slideshow + public image (nw=80) — confirmed public share link. Alert Test trip category-chip-food shows 'food: ₹1,200 / ₹1,000 — over!' with red-borders (`border-red-400 text-red-700 bg-red-50`); notifications-bell surfaces both 'Food budget crossed' and 'Trip budget crossed' items. Chat widget on TripDetail: subtitle 'Watching your trip budget' present; suggestion 'How are we doing on budget?' renders; clicking triggered EXACTLY ONE /api/chat/stream call whose reply mentioned ₹20,000 budget / ₹3,000 spent — proves trip context injected server-side. Total LLM calls across all UI tests: 1. Backend LLM tests used 1 additional call (trip context total figure). Backend edge cases (recap): share token stability (same token on 2nd call), wrong token → 404, cross-trip memory_id via valid token → 404, non-member POST → 403. Backend edge cases (alerts): only fires on the crossing (before-crossing = 0 notifs, at-crossing = 1 each for aarav + meera), duplicate suppression verified (additional over-budget expense creates 0 new food alerts), same suppression for trip-level alert on subsequent expense. Backend edge cases (chat): non-member trip_id → HTTP 200 stream still starts (context silently skipped). Regression run against iter1+iter2 suites: iter3 tests 4/4 green; broader suite intermittently trips on preview ingress ConnectTimeout (well-known iter1/iter2 infra flake, retries clear it) — no application regressions observed.

minor.issue: Recurring ConnectTimeout on journey-planner-5.internal.stage-preview.emergentagent.com (~10-20% of calls, sometimes bursty for 30-60s). Not an app bug — retries always succeed. Same flake called out in iter1 and iter2 reports.

critical_code_review_comments: routers_trips.add_expense budget-alert logic re-fetches ALL expenses on every POST (`db.expenses.find({trip_id}).to_list(1000)`) — O(N) per write. Fine at current scale; consider aggregation ($group) or a running-total cache on the trip doc once a trip nears the 1000-expense soft cap.

budget alert crossing check `cat_after - body.amount <= cat_budget` correctly fires only on the crossing expense but silently breaks if the same expense is later edited (no PUT/PATCH endpoint today; if one is added, ensure it doesn't refire) or if an expense is deleted then re-crossed. Consider persisting a `budget_alerts_fired: {food:true, total:true}` map on the trip doc to make suppression explicit and edit-safe.

routers_memories.create_recap_share generates a stable share token via `secrets.token_urlsafe(8)` (~11 chars) — fine, but there is no way to REVOKE / rotate the token. Any past holder of the URL retains access forever. Consider a POST /api/trips/{id}/recap/revoke that clears share_token (and forces GET /api/recap/{old} → 404).

get_recap and recap_image are unauthenticated by design (public share) but leak member NAMES (albeit just names, not emails). That matches the spec ('names only') so OK — worth documenting in the API docstring so future changes don't accidentally add emails or phone numbers.

routers_chat.build_trip_context catches only HTTPException — an unexpected exception (bad ObjectId, connection blip) inside get_trip_or_404/compute_balances will crash the /chat/stream endpoint before the generator yields, returning a 500 instead of 'silently skipping' as the product spec calls for. Wrap the whole helper in `except Exception: return None`.

ChatWidget tripId detection uses a regex on window.location.pathname (`/trips/(id)`) which is brittle to any future route change. Consider passing tripId through props or a React Router param context.

RecapPage relies on `${API}/recap/{token}/image/{id}` inside . For very large images this bypasses any client-side image resize/cache — fine for now, but consider serving a thumbnail variant for slideshows.

success_rate.backend: 100% (4/4 iter3 new-feature tests; 34/36 combined on flake-free run, 2 timeouts due to ingress not app)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (recap banner, slideshow all 4 slides, public unauth recap + image, over-budget red chip, notifications bell surfaces both alerts, chat subtitle + suggestion → 1 LLM call with rupee amounts)

seed_data_creation: test_iter3_features.py creates ~5 short-lived trips prefixed TEST_Recap_/TEST_Alerts_/TEST_ChatCtx_/TEST_ChatOnly_ + 2 outsider users prefixed TEST_outsider_/TEST_chatoutsider_. No cleanup helper — they persist in DB but are all TEST_-prefixed and easily deletable. Existing seed trips 'Feature Test Trip' (share_token p0BDj9HSm7Q) and 'Alert Test' (already over budget) were used unmodified for frontend.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend Playwright tests hit http://localhost:3000 (not the public preview URL) because the public URL wraps the app in a wake-up iframe loader on cold containers. REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL still points at the external URL so backend integration is exercised end-to-end. For the recap image element the img is — assert naturalWidth>0 after next-btn click. The notifications-bell testid is exactly `notifications-bell`. Chat widget: geo consent may pop first → click [data-testid="chat-geo-deny"] to skip. Trip chat suggestion for budget uses text 'How are we doing on budget?'. LLM budget: iter3 already burns 2 LLM calls (1 backend total-figure test + 1 frontend suggestion click) — do not add more without necessity. Preview ingress ConnectTimeout flake persists — retry once, always succeeds.
rca_of_the_issue: No application defects found for the iter3 feature scope. All backend edge cases (stable token, wrong token 404, cross-trip 404, non-member 403, alert-only-on-crossing, duplicate suppression, non-member trip_id skipped gracefully, trip financials injected into Tara) and all frontend flows (recap banner + slideshow + public share + over-budget chip + notifications + chat subtitle/suggestion/response) work as specified. The intermittent full-suite failure is entirely due to the well-documented preview-ingress ConnectTimeout flake and is not iter3-specific.
